configure_logger: configure a logger to write key-value diagnostics to stdout, log, csv, or tensorboard output formats
logkv_and_dumpkvs: log key-value pairs with logkv then write all diagnostics from the current iteration with dumpkvs
logkv_mean: log a value that gets averaged across multiple calls to logkv_mean before dumping with dumpkvs
profile_decorator: profile a function with the profile decorator to measure and log its execution wait time
scoped_configure: use scoped_configure as a context manager to temporarily switch logger directory and output formats
